interpretation_rules: no refit on scan or evaluation data; all model parameters were frozen before this comparison
report prediction error, never training R-squared
a CI crossing zero means compatible-with-zero, not equivalence and not proof of no effect
superiority of one model over another is claimed only if the paired-loss CI excludes zero
all signed errors preserved; no subset selection; negative observed effects kept as-is

metrics.primary: MAE over the 83 holdout rows per model
metrics.selection_regret: per capture: max_l Q_obs - Q_obs(argmax_l Q_pred) over the non-identity layouts; tie-break: smallest layout index in frozen manifest order

H_padding_linear.fit: least squares through the origin on the 216 frozen calibration out-of-fold rows only

models_compared.M0_raw: locked ridge on raw routing features (raw-r family); parameters frozen 2026-10-12
models_compared.M1_padding_128: locked ridge on 128-row padding-aware features; parameters frozen 2026-10-12
models_compared.M2_grouped_gemm: locked two-stage ridge (rank runner + completion); parameters frozen 2026-10-12

S_linear_no_plateau.fit: least squares through the origin on the 216 frozen calibration out-of-fold rows only

purpose: independent out-of-sample validation of the frozen candidate models on the 83 non-identity scan layouts (greedy-path prefixes spanning imbalanced to near-equilibrium), none of which was used in any calibration or evaluation fit

refreeze_note.reason: the first freeze omitted the analyzer hash binding; no comparison had been computed and no holdout value observed, so the spec was deleted and re-frozen with identical deterministic constants plus the analyzer record

target.definition: observed identity-cumulative start-level mean Q per (capture, layout) from the frozen scan analysis; identity rows excluded (trivially zero on both sides)
